<1% missing). Uses REST when huddle.api is available, else direct sqlite appends.

Run: python3 -m unittest tests.cluster.test_performance
"""
import statistics
import threading
import time
import unittest

from tests.cluster import harness as H

WRITERS_PER_NODE = 3
MSGS_PER_WRITER = 20
SUBS_PER_NODE = 3


class PerformanceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cluster = H.Cluster(nodes=3)
        self.use_api = H.api_available()
        if not self.use_api:
            self.db = self.cluster.connect()
            self.tokens = H.seed_minimal(self.db)
        self.cluster.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.cluster.stop)
        if self.use_api:
            api = self.api = H.Api()
            tok, _ = api.register(0, "perf_owner")
            _, gen = api.create_workspace(0, tok, "perf")
            self.cid = gen["id"]
            self.writer_tokens = [tok]
            for i in range(2):
                t, _ = api.register(i + 1, "perf_w%d" % i)
                api.join(i + 1, t, self.cid)
                self.writer_tokens.append(t)
            self.sub_token = self.writer_tokens[1]
        else:
            self.cid = 1
            self.sub_token = self.tokens["bob"]

    def test_latency(self):
        sent = {}
        recv = {}
        lock = threading.Lock()
        subs = []
        for node in range(3):
            for _ in range(SUBS_PER_NODE):
                w = self.cluster.ws(node, self.sub_token)
                self.addCleanup(w.close)
                w.send_json({"type": "subscribe", "channel_id": self.cid})
                self.assertIsNotNone(w.recv_until(lambda x: x.get("type") == "subscribed", 5))
                subs.append(w)
        stop = threading.Event()

        def reader(idx, w):
            while not stop.is_set():
                try:
                    f = w.recv_json(0.2)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    return
                if f and f.get("type") == "message.new":
                    with lock:
                        recv[(idx, f["message"]["body"])] = time.time()

        readers = [threading.Thread(target=reader, args=(i, w), daemon=True) for i, w in enumerate(subs)]
        for t in readers:
            t.start()
        errors = []

        def writer(node, wi):
            conn = None if self.use_api else self.cluster.connect()
            for m in range(MSGS_PER_WRITER):
                body = "p-%d-%d-%d" % (node, wi, m)
                t0 = time.time()
                with lock:
                    sent[body] = t0
                if self.use_api:
                    st, j = self.api.post(node, self.writer_tokens[(node + wi) % len(self.writer_tokens)], self.cid, body)
                    if st != 201:
                        errors.append((st, j))
                else:
                    H.append_event(conn, self.cid, "message.new", {"message": {"body": body}})
                time.sleep(0.02)

        writers = [threading.Thread(target=writer, args=(n, i)) for n in range(3) for i in range(WRITERS_PER_NODE)]
        t_start = time.time()
        for t in writers:
            t.start()
        for t in writers:
            t.join()
        time.sleep(2.0)
        stop.set()
        for t in readers:
            t.join(2)
        lat = []
        missing = 0
        for body, t0 in sent.items():
            for i in range(len(subs)):
                t1 = recv.get((i, body))
                if t1 is None:
                    missing += 1
                else:
                    lat.append(t1 - t0)
        total = len(sent) * len(subs)
        lat.sort()
        med = statistics.median(lat) if lat else float("inf")
        p95 = lat[int(len(lat) * 0.95) - 1] if lat else float("inf")
        print("\nperf: %d msgs x %d subs in %.1fs, median %.0f ms, p95 %.0f ms, missing %d/%d (api=%s, errors=%d)"
              % (len(sent), len(subs), time.time() - t_start, med * 1000, p95 * 1000, missing, total,
                 self.use_api, len(errors)))
        self.assertEqual(errors, [])

        self.assertLessEqual(p95, 0.800)

import unittest

from tests.api.helpers import call, register, make_ws, make_channel, uniq


class WorkspaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_create_and_list(self):
        u, tok = register()
        slug = uniq("acme-").replace("x", "-")
        r = call("POST", "/api/workspaces", {"slug": slug, "name": "Acme"}, tok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 201, r)
        ws = r.json["workspace"]
        self.assertEqual(ws["join_mode"], "open")
        self.assertEqual(ws["owner_id"], u["id"])
        self.assertEqual(r.json["general_channel"]["name"], "general")
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", "/api/workspaces", {"slug": slug, "name": "Acme"}, tok).status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", "/api/workspaces", {"slug": "Bad Slug", "name": "x"}, tok).status, 400)
        r = call("GET", "/api/workspaces", token=tok)
        self.assertIn(slug, [w["slug"] for w in r.json["workspaces"]])
        _, tok2 = register()
        r = call("GET", "/api/workspaces", token=tok2)
        self.assertNotIn(slug, [w["slug"] for w in r.json["workspaces"]])
        r = call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members", token=tok)
        self.assertEqual(r.json["members"][0]["role"], "owner")

    def test_detail_private_and_archived(self):
        owner, tok = register()
        ws, gen = make_ws(tok)
        priv = make_channel(tok, ws["slug"], is_private=True)
        arch = make_channel(tok, ws["slug"])
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/channels/{arch['id']}/archive", token=tok).status, 200)
        m, mtok = register()
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/channels/{gen['id']}/join", token=mtok).status, 200)
        r = call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{ws['slug']}", token=mtok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 200)
        ids = [c["id"] for c in r.json["channels"]]
        self.assertIn(gen["id"], ids)
        self.assertNotIn(priv["id"], ids)
        self.assertNotIn(arch["id"], ids)
        self.assertIn("read_state", r.json)
        for flag in ("1", "true"):
            r = call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{ws['slug']}", token=mtok, query={"include_archived": flag})
            self.assertIn(arch["id"], [c["id"] for c in r.json["channels"]])
        r = call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{ws['slug']}", token=tok)
        self.assertIn(priv["id"], [c["id"] for c in r.json["channels"]])

    def test_patch_workspace(self):
        _, tok = register()
        ws, gen = make_ws(tok)
        r = call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{ws['slug']}", {"name": "Renamed", "join_mode": "invite_only"}, tok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(r.json["workspace"]["join_mode"], "invite_only")
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{ws['slug']}", {"join_mode": "bogus"}, tok).status, 400)
        _, t2 = register()
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{ws['slug']}", {"name": "x"}, t2).status, 403)
        # invite_only: non-member cannot join channel
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/channels/{gen['id']}/join", token=t2).status, 403)

    def test_roles(self):
        owner, otok = register()
        ws, gen = make_ws(otok)
        slug = ws["slug"]
        a, atok = register()
        b, btok = register()
        c, ctok = register()
        for t in (atok, btok, ctok):
            self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/channels/{gen['id']}/join", token=t).status, 200)
        r = call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{a['id']}", {"role": "admin"}, otok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 200, r)
        self.assertEqual(r.json["member"]["role"], "admin")
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{b['id']}", {"role": "owner"}, otok).status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{owner['id']}", {"role": "admin"}, atok).status, 403)
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{owner['id']}", {"role": "member"}, otok).status, 403)
        # admin promotes b to admin, then cannot modify b
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{b['id']}", {"role": "admin"}, atok).status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{b['id']}", {"role": "member"}, atok).status, 403)
        # member cannot change roles
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{a['id']}", {"role": "member"}, ctok).status, 403)
        # guest restrictions
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{c['id']}", {"role": "guest"}, otok).status, 200)
        pub = make_channel(otok, slug)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/channels/{pub['id']}/join", token=ctok).status, 403)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/channels", {"name": "nope"}, ctok).status, 403)
        # member cannot create private channel, can create public
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{c['id']}", {"role": "member"}, otok).status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/channels", {"name": "secret", "is_private": True}, ctok).status, 403)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/channels", {"name": "open-one"}, ctok).status, 201)

        owner, otok = register()
        ws, gen = make_ws(otok)

        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/transfer_ownership", {"new_owner_id": a["id"]}, atok).status, 403)
        call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members/{a['id']}", {"role": "admin"}, otok)
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/transfer_ownership", {"new_owner_id": a["id"]}, otok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 200, r)
        self.assertEqual(r.json["workspace"]["owner_id"], a["id"])
        roles = {m["user_id"]: m["role"] for m in call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/members", token=otok).json["members"]}
        self.assertEqual(roles[a["id"]], "owner")
        self.assertEqual(roles[owner["id"]], "admin")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

BOUNDARY = "----huddleTestBoundary7MA4YWxk"


def multipart(filename, data, ctype="text/plain", field="file"):

            f"--{BOUNDARY}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{field}\"; filename=\"{filename}\"\r\n"
            f"Content-Type: {ctype}\r\n\r\n").encode() + data + f"\r\n--{BOUNDARY}--\r\n".encode()
    return body, {"Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={BOUNDARY}"}


class FileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def upload(self, tok, name="a.txt", data=b"hello file", ctype="text/plain"):
        body, h = multipart(name, data, ctype)
        return call("POST", "/api/files", token=tok, raw=body, headers=h)

    def test_upload_get_download(self):
        u, tok = register()
        data = bytes(range(256)) * 10 + b"\r\n--notboundary\r\n"
        r = self.upload(tok, "pic.bin", data, "application/octet-stream")
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 201, r)
        f = r.json["file"]
        for k in ("id", "uploader_id", "filename", "content_type", "size", "created_at"):
            self.assertIn(k, f)
        self.assertEqual(f["size"], len(data))
        self.assertEqual(f["uploader_id"], u["id"])
        r = call("GET", f"/api/files/{f['id']}", token=tok)
        self.assertEqual(r.json["file"]["filename"], "pic.bin")
        r = call("GET", f"/api/files/{f['id']}/download", token=tok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(r.data, data)
        self.assertEqual(r.content_type, "application/octet-stream")
        self.assertIn("pic.bin", r.headers["Content-Disposition"])
        self.assertEqual(call("GET", "/api/files/99999999", token=tok).status, 404)

        _, tok = register()
        r = self.upload(tok, "big.bin", b"x" * (config.MAX_UPLOAD + 1))
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 413)

    def test_missing_part(self):
        _, tok = register()
        body, h = multipart("a.txt", b"zz", field="other")
        body = body.replace(b'; filename="a.txt"', b"")
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", "/api/files", token=tok, raw=body, headers=h).status, 400)

import unittest

from tests.api.helpers import call, register, make_ws


class GroupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_groups_crud(self):
        owner, otok = register()
        ws, gen = make_ws(otok)
        slug = ws["slug"]
        a, atok = register()
        b, btok = register()
        for t in (atok, btok):
            call("POST", f"/api/channels/{gen['id']}/join", token=t)
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups", {"handle": "devs", "name": "Devs", "user_ids": [a["id"]]}, atok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 201, r)
        g = r.json["group"]
        self.assertEqual(g["member_user_ids"], [a["id"]])
        self.assertNotIn("members", g)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups", {"handle": "devs", "name": "x"}, atok).status, 409)
        r = call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups", token=btok)
        self.assertEqual([x["handle"] for x in r.json["groups"]], ["devs"])
        self.assertEqual(call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups/devs", {"name": "x"}, btok).status, 403)
        r = call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups/devs", {"user_ids": [a["id"], b["id"]]}, otok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(r.json["group"]["member_user_ids"]), sorted([a["id"], b["id"]]))
        self.assertEqual(call("DELETE", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups/devs", token=btok).status, 403)
        r = call("DELETE", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups/devs", token=atok)
        self.assertEqual((r.status, r.json), (200, {"deleted": True}))
        r = call("DELETE", f"/api/workspaces/{slug}/groups/devs", token=atok)
        self.assertEqual((r.status, r.json), (200, {"deleted": True}))


class InvitationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.owner, self.otok = register()
        self.ws, self.gen = make_ws(self.otok)
        self.slug = self.ws["slug"]
        call("PATCH", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}", {"join_mode": "invite_only"}, self.otok)

    def test_basic_accept(self):
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", {}, self.otok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 201, r)
        inv = r.json["invitation"]
        self.assertEqual(inv["max_uses"], 1)
        code = inv["code"]
        r = call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", token=self.otok)
        self.assertIn(code, [i["code"] for i in r.json["invitations"]])
        u, tok = register()
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/channels/{self.gen['id']}/join", token=tok).status, 403)
        r = call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{code}/accept", token=tok)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, 200, r)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/channels/{self.gen['id']}/join", token=tok).status, 200)
        _, tok2 = register()
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{code}/accept", token=tok2).status, 404)  # exhausted
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", "/api/invitations/nonexistent/accept", token=tok2).status, 404)
        # non-admin cannot create/list
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", {}, tok).status, 403)
        self.assertEqual(call("GET", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", token=tok).status, 403)

    def test_targeted_expired_revoked(self):
        t, ttok = register()
        o, otok2 = register()
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", {"invited_user_id": t["id"], "max_uses": 5}, self.otok)
        inv = r.json["invitation"]
        self.assertEqual(inv["max_uses"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{inv['code']}/accept", token=otok2).status, 403)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{inv['code']}/accept", token=ttok).status, 200)
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", {"invited_username": o["username"]}, self.otok)
        self.assertEqual(r.json["invitation"]["invited_user_id"], o["id"])
        # expired
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", {"expires_in_seconds": 1}, self.otok)
        from huddle.api.db import get_conn
        get_conn().execute("UPDATE invitations SET expires_at=1 WHERE code=?", (r.json["invitation"]["code"],))
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{r.json['invitation']['code']}/accept", token=otok2).status, 404)
        # revoked
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", {"max_uses": 3}, self.otok)
        code = r.json["invitation"]["code"]
        r = call("DELETE", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations/{code}", token=self.otok)
        self.assertEqual((r.status, r.json), (200, {"deleted": True}))
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{code}/accept", token=otok2).status, 404)
        # multi-use
        r = call("POST", f"/api/workspaces/{self.slug}/invitations", {"max_uses": 2}, self.otok)
        code = r.json["invitation"]["code"]
        _, x1 = register()
        _, x2 = register()
        _, x3 = register()
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{code}/accept", token=x1).status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{code}/accept", token=x2).status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(call("POST", f"/api/invitations/{code}/accept", token=x3).status, 404)

    unittest.main()
